## Jadwal Semester

::: {.callout-note}
Tanggal di bawah adalah **estimasi**, dihitung dari tanggal riil Moodle/SCELE
PBP Ganjil 2025/2026 yang digeser tepat 52 minggu (sehingga hari Senin/Rabu
tetap konsisten). Akan diperbarui begitu kalender akademik & jadwal Moodle
resmi Gasal 2026/2027 terbit. Baris bertanda (*) adalah perkiraan tambahan
karena tidak ada data eksplisit di sumber Moodle tahun lalu.
:::

### Materi, Tutorial & Tugas Individu Mingguan

Kelas tatap muka berlangsung **Senin & Rabu** setiap minggu (materi yang
sama disampaikan di kedua sesi). Tutorial dikerjakan & dinilai di sesi lab
hari Rabu (rilis dan deadline di hari yang sama); Tugas Individu rilis
hari Rabu dan deadline Rabu minggu berikutnya.

## Semester Schedule

::: {.callout-note}
Dates below are **estimates**, calculated from the real Moodle/SCELE dates
of PBP Odd Semester 2025/2026 shifted by exactly 52 weeks (so Monday/
Wednesday stay consistent). Will be updated once the official 2026/2027
academic calendar and Moodle schedule are published. Rows marked (*) are
additional estimates, as no explicit data existed in last year's Moodle
source for them.
:::

### Weekly Materials, Tutorials & Individual Assignments

In-person classes run **Monday & Wednesday** every week (the same
material is delivered in both sessions). Tutorials are done & graded
during the Wednesday lab session (release and deadline on the same day);
Individual Assignments are released Wednesday and due the following
Wednesday.
